logline: As Rupert and Catherine issue wedding invitations paired with Juliana's public execution decree to terrorize the county, Juliana endures starvation in the dungeon, refusing to break her spirit.
continuity_notes: Following Alexander's vow to return in two days to disrupt the wedding, Rupert and Catherine prepare to cement their coup by inviting high society to celebrate their nuptials and witness Juliana's execution.

scenes.heading: INT. ASHBRIDGE MANOR - GRAND CORRIDOR – DAY

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot tilting down to a polished mahogany table as a white-gloved servant places a tall stack of wax-sealed wedding invitations onto a silver tray.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: The crisp tap of heavy cardstock envelopes being set down onto silver.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot framed symmetrically down the vaulted, sunlit hallway. Blond Nobleman Rupert stands tall in a black embroidered frock coat, facing Catherine in an ornate pink gown.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Rupert) (Cold, Calculating)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Every important family in the county should witness it.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine looking down at the invitations, her braided blonde hair immaculately pinned, before she raises her eyes with a slight smirk.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Inquiring, Smug)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: The wedding?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Rupert, his sharp aristocratic features set in cold conviction.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Rupert) (Authoritative)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: The transfer of Ashbridge.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Catherine picking up one of the invitations, turning it over in her gloved hands with predatory delight.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Gloating)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: After the ceremony, no one will question who owns this house.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Intense close-up of Rupert leaning in slightly, his eyes narrowing with venomous malice.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Rupert) (Sinister, Ruthless)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: And no one will question what happened to the woman who tried to stop us.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of Catherine as a cruel sneer twists her lips.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Venomous Satisfaction)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Juliana's execution comes after the wedding.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot framing the two conspirators beneath the towering archways of the estate.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Gleeful)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Perfect timing. It will be a feast for our guests.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Rupert turning his gaze toward the grand entrance.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Rupert) (Decisive)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Send the invitations.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine looking sideways with narrowed eyes.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Spiteful)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Especially to the Ashcrofts.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide tracking shot down a palatial marble hall as a butler carries a silver tray toward double doors.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot inside an opulent drawing room with a roaring fireplace. Lady Clarissa sits gracefully in an emerald satin gown as the butler presents the tray.

segments.label: BUTLER (Formal)
segments.speaker: BUTLER
segments.text: Lady Clarissa, an invitation from Ashbridge Manor.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Clarissa takes the cream envelope, breaks the red wax seal with her gloved thumbs, and slides out the heavy card.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Clarissa's face lighting up with malicious excitement, the warm hearth flickering in the background.

segments.label: LADY CLARISSA (Amused, Thrilled)
segments.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
segments.text: Catherine's wedding.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot as her dark-haired husband steps up behind her chair, crossing his arms.

segments.label: NOBLEMAN (Observant)
segments.speaker: NOBLEMAN
segments.text: So it is finally official.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Clarissa smiling down at the calligraphy.

segments.label: LADY CLARISSA (Mockingly Reverent)
segments.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
segments.text: Lady Catherine Ashbridge.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot as Clarissa unfolds the second page attached to the invitation, her expression shifting to intrigue.

segments.label: LADY CLARISSA (Intrigued)
segments.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
segments.text: And after the ceremony...

segments.label: NOBLEMAN (Curious)
segments.speaker: NOBLEMAN
segments.text: What?

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Clarissa hands the letter upward to him. He takes it and looks down at the bold heading.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the nobleman reading, his eyes widening in shock before breaking into a grin.

segments.label: NOBLEMAN (Reading in Awe)
segments.speaker: NOBLEMAN
segments.text: The sentencing of the condemned.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Clarissa turning back to the fire, laughing softly with dark delight.

segments.label: LADY CLARISSA (Gloating, Mocking)
segments.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
segments.text: They want the families to witness it.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the nobleman holding the invitation, chuckling at the audacity.

segments.label: NOBLEMAN (Fascinated)
segments.speaker: NOBLEMAN
segments.text: A public execution after a wedding.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium profile shot of Clarissa gazing back at him over her shoulder.

segments.label: LADY CLARISSA (Chilling, Sharp)
segments.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
segments.text: Not just an execution. A warning.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the nobleman's stern face, leaning down.

segments.label: NOBLEMAN (Curious)
segments.speaker: NOBLEMAN
segments.text: To whom?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Clarissa taking the letter back into her gloved fingers, her eyes gleaming with aristocratic cruelty.

segments.label: LADY CLARISSA (Contemptuous, Scornful)
segments.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
segments.text: To every woman who thinks she can rise above the place she was given.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of the parlor as Clarissa tosses the invitation dismissively onto the side table and looks directly toward the viewer.

segments.label: LADY CLARISSA (Smug Triumph)
segments.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
segments.text: Juliana's ruin will be a lesson. And we will be there to watch.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide, dim shot of the subterranean stone dungeon. Juliana sits slumped against a weeping stone wall on the wet floor, dressed in a tattered prison smock, illuminated only by faint overhead moonlight piercing a ceiling grate.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Rhythmic water drips splashing onto stagnant dungeon puddles and a low, mournful ambient drone.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's bruised hand, locked in a heavy iron shackle chained to the wall, trembling as she hesitates inches away from a dirty earthen bowl filled with murky liquid.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana curls her fingers back, pulling away from the foul sustenance in defiance.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of Juliana's dirty, tear-stained face. Her eyes squeeze shut as tears stream down her cheeks from overwhelming physical agony and hunger.

segments.label: JULIANA (Weak, Whispering through Tears)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: They think hunger will make me surrender.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's blue eyes snapping open, blazing with unyielding defiance.

segments.label: JULIANA (Fierce Resolve)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: They think fear will make me beg.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Full shot of Juliana using her bare hands against the slimy stone floor to drag herself upright to her knees, chains rattling loudly.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: The harsh scrape and clatter of heavy iron chains dragging across wet stone.

segments.label: JULIANA (Straining, Defiant Gasps)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I will not!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot looking up at Juliana as she thrusts her chin high toward the iron ceiling grate, bathed in cold shafts of light.

segments.label: JULIANA (Passionate Defiance)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: They can take my name. They can take my home.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of Juliana's iron-shackled hand reaching out and gripping the massive iron ring anchored into the dungeon pillar with crushing determination.

segments.label: JULIANA (Indomitable Spirit)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: They cannot take who I am!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot in the dimly lit parlor, illuminated by the warm glow of the fireplace. Clarissa now wears a deep blue velvet gown, reclining in an armchair beside the nobleman.

segments.label: NOBLEMAN (Quietly Skeptical)
segments.speaker: NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Do you think she'll actually be executed?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Clarissa giving a slight, dismissive scoff before turning to him with cold certainty.

segments.label: LADY CLARISSA (Dismissive, Certain)
segments.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
segments.text: After what she has been accused of? Of course.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of the nobleman looking down pensively at the open execution clause on the table.

segments.label: NOBLEMAN (Musing)
segments.speaker: NOBLEMAN
segments.text: She was always stubborn.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Clarissa's face hardening with bitter resentment.

segments.label: LADY CLARISSA (Bitter, Cold)
segments.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
segments.text: That was her greatest mistake. She could have accepted what happened. She could have disappeared quietly.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Clarissa rises from her armchair holding a cut crystal glass filled with dark red wine, pacing toward the fireplace.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium tracking shot showing Clarissa standing tall beside her husband, her posture regal and vindictive.

segments.label: LADY CLARISSA (Venomous Monologue)
segments.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
segments.text: Instead she married a nobody, played healer to peasants, challenged people above her. And now the whole county will watch her pay for it.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up on Clarissa's face glowing in the firelight. Her lips curl into a merciless smile as she lifts the crystal glass to her mouth and drinks.

segments.label: LADY CLARISSA (Chilling Proclamation)
segments.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
segments.text: Let them see what happens when a woman forgets her place.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Clarissa takes a slow sip of the red wine, her eyes gleaming with dark relish.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Slow push-in on the dark polished tabletop where the open invitation lies beside the wax seal. The bold Gothic lettering "EXECUTION CLAUSE" sits beneath the gold crest, while the fire dances reflected on the mahogany.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: A deep, ominous cello rumble builds alongside the crackle of the fireplace into an unresolved, tension-filled cliffhanger sting before fading out.
